title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-eden-2026-03-06
body:
Personal triage scratchpad — Eden Park

Date: 2026-03-06
Context:
- Customer (Acme Payments) reported dashboard rendering errors + stale metrics on hosted console route /dashboards/usage. Reported by CSM during onboarding call.
- Observed spike in 5xxs around 2026-03-05 22:40 UTC correlated with a deployment to console-service (PR 1284).
- Ticket: JIRA INF-3421 created by CS. Follow-ups tracked in INF-3422 for dashboard query regressions.

What I saw / quick repro:
- Dashboard widgets using promQL queries 'sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route)' return empty series intermittently.
- Grafana panels (embedded) show 'no data' while raw prom responses sometimes return payload with no samples.
- Reproduce steps:
  1) curl -s "https://prometheus.internal/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(requests_total%5B5m%5D))%20by%20(route)" | jq .
  2) Hit /dashboards/usage in incognito to replicate UI state.
- Log snippets (console-service):
  - 2026-03-05T22:40:12Z ERROR fetchMetrics handler failed: timeout waiting for remote prom response
  - 2026-03-05T22:40:12Z WARN cache miss for query key=usage_routes_v2

Initial hypotheses:
- Prometheus scrape hiccup or remote read timeouts causing empty responses; console doesn't gracefully fallback to cached values (cache TTL maybe too short).
- Recent PR 1284 changed query batching behavior, might cause longer query latencies under high cardinality.
- Autoscaling / DNS flapping during the deploy window (need SRE input).

Immediate actions taken (today):
- Re-ran the query at 22:50 and 23:05 UTC — intermittent failures, not constant.
- Reverted PR 1284 in staging to reproduce; staging shows reduced latency -> indicates PR likely culprit.
- Opened INF-3422 for reproducible promQL regression and linked to INF-3421 (customer-facing).
- Posted interim note in #console-observability with logs and initial triage summary (link above).

Next steps / TODOs (prioritized):
- [ ] Ping SRE (Samir) to check infra/autoscaling/DNS around 2026-03-05 22:30-23:00 (owner: Samir Rao) — target: today EOD.
- [ ] Add additional retry/backoff for remote_read calls in console-service (owner: Jordan Li) — low-risk patch.
- [ ] Extend cache TTL for usage_routes_v2 to 60s as temporary mitigation (owner: Eden) — quick deploy.
- [ ] Add dashboard-level health indicator when prom returns no data (UX/Product) — sync with Priya.
- [ ] Run load test reproducing high-cardinality queries with PR 1284 in staging (owner: Jordan) — blockers: infra time.
- [ ] Draft customer update for Acme (CS to send) explaining mitigation steps & ETA (owner: Priya)

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- Need to capture exact prom query examples that fail and save them in INF-3422 (copy into ticket body).
- Check if query-result size exceeded some limit or if vector matching behavior changed after the batching refactor.
- If revert in prod necessary, get approval from oncall and PM (Priya) — prefer a config flag toggle.
- Remind: follow up on observability dashboard tests in CI (flake maybe introduced by PR 1284)

Links & refs:
- INF-3421 (customer-facing): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3421
- INF-3422 (internal repro): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3422
- PR 1284 (console): https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1284
- Thread: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Customer-Dashboard-Issue
- Slack thread: #console-observability (see slack://channel/C04ABCD1234)

Unresolved questions:
- Does the console-service have any recent changes to the Prometheus client lib that would alter vector responses?
- Is there a configured request timeout mismatch between console and remote_prom read endpoints?

Quick log of actions (timeboxed):
- 09:15 AM — triage, reproduce, open INF-3422
- 10:00 AM — post in Slack + tag SRE
- 11:30 AM — revert candidate tested in staging

Status: draft — will update after SRE response and staging load test.

-- Eden
